text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah I am! If Golshi-chan doesn't 
celebrate, who will?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aren't we best buds, the kind that cat and 
mouse, detective and phantom thief, and 
Tasmanian devil and wombat would envy?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No matter how old we get, let's keep 
having our friendly brawls☆

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...If you wouldn't obstruct school 
affairs, there would be no need for us to 
crack down on you, would there?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I expect you to reform yourself promptly 
and uphold the rules and order as a model 
student.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~? A quiet Golshi-chan would be like 
cacio e pepe without the cheese, wouldn't 
it!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Since today is my birthday, would you not 
mind granting me a wish?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Guh~! Well, when you put it like that~! 
—Alright!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Understood, sir! Yours truly, Golshi, 
shall follow your example and act with 
utmost diligence, sir! Problem child 
secured, GOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! ...Today marks the 
anniversary of Golshi-san's 
rehabilitation, too.
